title: i read apogee last night and life will never be the same #heatedrival...
transcript: We allowed to talk about fanfic on main? I'm like not sure, but warning warning. Trigger warning for fanfic. I don't know about you, but I cannot stop reading Heated Rivalry fanfic. Like I have consumed so much. I have not been a consistent fanfic person my entire life, but I have gone through like very heavy fanfic sections of my life and right now I'm so deep in. And at first it was just like Canon Heated Rivalry Fanfic. Shane in Montreal, Ilya in Boston. Both of them on the centaurs. Like post long game or maybe like slight canon divergence? Read every single like someone gets injured and the other one is their emergency contact fanfic in the whole world. I feel like every social media fic that exists. But then I read Wolfbird. Wolfbird ruined my life cause before then I was sort of not into the AU of it all. I was like no, I want them as hockey players and in woldbird. Shane is a hockey player. llya is not. And it broke something up here. The floodgates have opened. Shane and Ilya in space. Shane and Ilya do ballet. Shane as a pop star, Ilya as a bodyguard. Shane as a veterinarian. Shane and Ilya as childhood best friends. Or in college. Or all. All the things. Now I'll read all of it. I'll read anything. I'll read anything that's about Shane and Ilya. I don't care where they're set, I don't care what they're Doing as long as it's Shane and Ilya falling in love over and over and over and over again. And I just think it is so beautiful and it's some of the best writing I've ever read. Like, what. What am I doing? Truly nothing that brings me more joy in my soul than 100,000 already completed fanfic with 25 chapters. No, I have not and will not read any of the not happy ending ones. Do not recommend the Ilya dying in a plane crash fanfic. I will not read it. All this to say, drop your fanfic recs And more than that, how do you track your fanfic? Because I have no, I've never made like a way to track the fanfic that I'm reading. And it's starting to drive me crazy cause I'm like, have I already read this? All the titles are long and ridiculous and I just losing my mind. Okay, thanks.
